description: Ficus is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by Institute for Energy Economy and Application Technology. A (mixed integer) linear optimisation model for local energy systems. Coverage: user-defined regions (as stated on the fact sheet). The fact sheet classes it as: energy system optimization model,. Sectors: electricity, heating,.... Resolution: time 15 Minute. Data availability is given as "some". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
